interpretation: An event-driven vector of present external cues, separate learned cue-outcome posteriors, categorical temporal status, objective controllability, world ambiguity and outcome resolution. It is not a scalar threat, fear or anxiety value.

scientific_conceptual_basis.title: Understanding anxiety symptoms as aberrant defensive responding along the threat imminence continuum
scientific_conceptual_basis.use: Supports representing temporal proximity as a separate defensive-context dimension; it does not provide these software categories as a numeric biological scale.

scientific_conceptual_basis.title: Computational perspectives on human fear and anxiety
scientific_conceptual_basis.use: Supports keeping learned prediction, uncertainty and approach-avoidance constructs computationally distinguishable.

scientific_conceptual_basis.title: Role of the medial prefrontal cortex in coping and resilience
scientific_conceptual_basis.use: Supports treating controllability as consequential while distinguishing objective control from unimplemented perceived or learned control.

scientific_conceptual_basis.title: Human Pavlovian fear conditioning conforms to probabilistic learning
scientific_conceptual_basis.use: Provides the existing cue-outcome posterior state attached without modification to each current context.

ontology_classification: ENGINEERING ONTOLOGY informed by scientific concepts; not a published numeric biological scale and not claimed to reproduce the Predatory Imminence Continuum.
posterior_dependency: Exact alpha, beta, posterior mean, posterior variance and resolved-observation count are inherited from probabilistic-threat-learning-v1. No new probability calculation is introduced.
state_lifecycle: Changes only when a structured environment record opens, updates or resolves a context. No time decay or interpolation occurs between events.
producer_requirement: An unresolved context remains active until a later structured environment event uses the same context_id and explicitly resolves it. Producers that omit that closure leave the context active by design.

controllability_distinction.objective_controllability: LIVE only as an exact structured world category
controllability_distinction.learned_action_outcome_contingency: LIVE as separately attached observational evidence; not a context score

engineering_constants.name: state_schema_version
engineering_constants.classification: storage compatibility; not a psychological parameter

limitations: The structured environment producer, not this subsystem, determines whether a cue is present and assigns temporal, objective-control, ambiguity and resolution categories.
An unresolved context cannot close without a later structured event carrying the same context_id and explicit resolution facts.
Learned posterior assumptions remain binary, stationary and independent exactly as defined by probabilistic-threat-learning-v1.

Public summaries omit exact cue-outcome posterior parameters and all source event identifiers; separately attached action-outcome aggregates retain their exact public posterior evidence under that model's boundary.
No biological activation, subjective response or attentional priority is inferred from this factual vector.
